title: Machan Story Book Deck
project: Machan story: the video is the movie, the carousel is the book
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

pairs.ask: How does the video hand off to the carousel?

optionA.label: Last frame becomes page one
optionA.desc: The video freezes and turns into the first book page.
optionA.more: Movie version flows into the book version, no choice.

optionB.label: Page turn sweeps in
optionB.desc: A page turn wipes over the video end.

pairs.ask: Which arrows move the book? (pitch-deck arrows, redesigned)

optionA.label: Round terracotta arrows
optionA.desc: The pitch-deck circle arrows, now terracotta with shine.
optionA.more: Your note: reuse the pitch arrows.

optionA.label: Brush draws it in
optionA.desc: Near the end, a brush writes 真工素 stroke by stroke.

optionB.label: Glows behind the wish slide
optionB.desc: Faint 真工素 behind "May all things go as you wish."

optionA.label: Storybook painterly
optionA.desc: Same look as the video (your pick).

optionB.label: Woodblock prints
optionB.desc: Hokusai-style flat colour for the book only.

pairs.ask: In the book, the tiger is…

optionB.label: Shown once, last page
optionB.desc: The book reveals him at the very end.

pairs.ask: How many words on each page?

optionA.label: Eleven
optionA.desc: Eleven pages, like an eleven-card deck.

pairs.ask: Little art on the Greek name slide (decided: Little Cloud). Its colour?

optionB.label: Cream cloud, gold edge
optionB.desc: Cream cloud with a thin gold line.

optionA.label: Wish plus wink
optionA.desc: "May all things go as you wish. ;)"

optionB.label: Wish plus "Read the seed"
optionB.desc: Both catchphrases, one under the other.

optionA.label: Music carries on
optionA.desc: The video's playful music keeps playing softly.

optionB.label: Page-turn sounds only
optionB.desc: Silence plus a soft paper turn.

pairs.ask: How does the book live on X?

optionA.label: Carousel post right after the video
optionA.desc: Video post, then the book as an image carousel reply.
optionA.more: No choice: book follows the movie.

optionB.label: Book on the story page only
optionB.desc: X links to the story page for the book.
